title: An order-to-disorder structural switch regulates HIF-1 transcription through S247 phosphorylation in the HIF1alpha PAS-B domain.
authors: Hsu, Chia-Hung; Chen, Ya-Jyun; Yang, Chia-Ning
one_liner_zh: 通过GaMD模拟揭示HIF1alpha PAS-B域S247磷酸化诱导的有序-无序结构开关调控HIF-1转录的别构机制，属于TF复合物蛋白-DNA互作上游调控的物理模拟研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: Hypoxia-inducible factor 1 (HIF-1), a transcriptional activator that mediates cellular responses to hypoxic stress, is essential for tumor progression. It is a heterodimer comprising HIF1alpha and HIF1beta, with multiple interfaces among their PAS-A, PAS-B, and bHLH domains. HIF1beta is also known as aryl hydrocarbon receptor nuclear translocator (ARNT). Casein kinase 1delta-dependent phosphorylation of the solvent-front residue S247 on the HIF1alpha PAS-B domain interrupts HIF1alpha-ARNT complex formation and reduces HIF-1 transcription activity. However, S247 is involved in neither HIF1alpha-ARNT complex formation nor stabilization of the relative orientation between the HIF1alpha PAS-A and PAS-B domains. To uncover the underlying allosteric mechanism, we conducted Gaussian accelerated molecular dynamics simulations and identified two distinct conformations of the pS247-carrying HIF1alpha PAS-B domain: H291-in and H291-out. The H291-in structure can associate with the HIF1alpha PAS-A domain and form a V-shaped pouch to accommodate the ARNT PAS-A domain, but it cannot associate with the ARNT PAS-B domain. By contrast, the H291-out structure can bind to the ARNT PAS-B domain, but its association with the HIF1alpha PAS-A domain leads to an unsuitable relative orientation to accommodate the ARNT PAS-A domain. Both conformations were also collected in parallel simulations of the unphosphorylated PAS-B domain. Both structures manage to associate with the ARNT PAS-B and HIF1alpha PAS-A domains; thus, they are adequate for HIF1alpha-ARNT complex formation. The domain-domain contact pattern in a phosphorylated variant is shuffled by an order-to-disorder structural switch, triggered by the newly formed K251-pS247 interaction.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子1（HIF-1）是一种介导细胞对低氧应激反应的转录激活因子，对肿瘤进展至关重要。它是一个由HIF1alpha和HIF1beta组成的异二聚体，其PAS-A、PAS-B和bHLH结构域之间存在多个相互作用界面。HIF1beta也被称为芳烃受体核转位蛋白（ARNT）。酪蛋白激酶1δ依赖的HIF1alpha PAS-B结构域溶剂前沿残基S247的磷酸化会中断HIF1alpha-ARNT复合物的形成，并降低HIF-1转录活性。然而，S247既不参与HIF1alpha-ARNT复合物的形成，也不参与稳定HIF1alpha PAS-A和PAS-B结构域之间的相对取向。为揭示其潜在的变构机制，我们进行了高斯加速分子动力学模拟，并识别出携带pS247的HIF1alpha PAS-B结构域的两种不同构象：H291-in和H291-out。H291-in结构能与HIF1alpha PAS-A结构域结合，形成V形口袋以容纳ARNT PAS-A结构域，但不能与ARNT PAS-B结构域结合。相比之下，H291-out结构能与ARNT PAS-B结构域结合，但其与HIF1alpha PAS-A结构域的结合会导致不适宜的相对取向，无法容纳ARNT PAS-A结构域。在未磷酸化PAS-B结构域的平行模拟中也收集到了这两种构象。两种结构均能与ARNT PAS-B和HIF1alpha PAS-A结构域结合，因此它们足以支持HIF1alpha-ARNT复合物的形成。在磷酸化变体中，结构域间接触模式通过由新形成的K251-pS247相互作用触发的有序到无序结构转换而被重新排列。
